task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue emergency imperial decree declaring the epidemic a national crisis, authorize extraordinary mobilization of treasury and granaries, and publicly legitimize quarantine measures across all affected cities.

Coordinate regional response in each affected major city: enforce city-gate screening, seal infected wards, organize local relief distribution, and submit daily mortality and resource reports back to the central court.

Stand up the bureaucratic apparatus: requisition physicians and medicinal supplies, coordinate transport of food and medicine to besieged cities, staff lazarets and isolation facilities, and maintain a running ledger of casualties and supplies.

Enforce quarantine decrees, suppress hoarding and price gouging of medicine and grain, prevent flight from infected cities that would spread the contagion, and prosecute anyone deliberately spreading the disease or subverting public-health orders.
